# situation: the bundle-size workflow of the TanStack incident (2026-05-11)
#   with cache-mode: write: pull_request_target checks out the merge of the
#   pull request, a composite action of another repository sets up pnpm
#   with actions/cache, and a build runs the pull request's code.
# reason: cache-mode: write lets the job save to the cache of the default
#   branch's scope on pull_request_target; the build runs the author's
#   code, which changes the pnpm store that the post step of actions/cache
#   saves under the key the release workflow looks up.
# attack-value: the file packages/history/vite_setup.mjs in the pull request = "console.log('PWNED')"
# attack-run-behavior: the checkout fetches refs/pull/<n>/merge, the build
#   runs the pull request's code, which writes into the pnpm store; at the
#   end of the job actions/cache saves the store to the default branch's
#   scope, and the release workflow restores it and runs it.
on: workflow_call
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  benchmark-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    cache-mode: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/merge
      - uses: TanStack/config/.github/setup@main
      - run: pnpm nx run @benchmarks/bundle-size:build
